headline: US Aims to Loan Heating Oil Reserve to Tame Prices
summary: The United States plans to loan about a third of its heating oil reserve in an effort to tame soaring costs ahead of the November elections.
why: Emergency releases or loans from national energy reserves are policy tools used to influence short-term commodity prices and ease consumer inflationary pressures.

impacts.name: Heating Oil
impacts.why: Emergency reserve loans are policy tools intended to increase short-term supply and ease soaring commodity prices.

why_moved: The United States planned to loan a third of its heating oil reserve to tame soaring costs ahead of elections, serving as a direct policy tool to influence short-term commodity prices.
